what: Every Go chapter stylesheet carries a bare `.term { white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }`, which overrides the engine on ALL terminals, not just `.term.wrap`: lines wrap to column 0 with no hanging indent and break in the middle of tokens, so real output reads as different text on phones.
evidence: go-ch21.css:25, go-ch22.css:24, go-ch23.css:29, go-ch24.css:23, go-ch25.css:23 (same line in go-ch1-28 and js-ch15; not in engine-refresh-chapter-todo §1, which only lists `.term.wrap` copies). Crops: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-go-21-25/a22/w390-006-p3.png, /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-go-21-25/a25/w390-010-p5.png, /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-go-21-25/a21/w390-009-p5.png.
fix: Before → After (why): `.term { white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }` (in 28 Go files) → delete it and put `class="term wrap"` on the terminals that need wrapping (the engine's `.term.wrap` breaks at spaces only, keeps a hanging indent, and lets a single long token scroll instead of splitting it). what: The baton animation breaks the motion rules: 600ms with the weak built-in `ease-out`, sliding from -40px with a -12° spin and no opacity, and it replays on every Next/Back press (including keyboard steps).
evidence: go-ch24.css:105-107: `.motion .cs-baton.go { animation: csPass 0.6s ease-out; }`, `@keyframes csPass { from { transform: translateX(-40px) rotate(-12deg); } }`; go-ch24.js:179 re-creates `<span class="cs-baton go">` on every render, so stepping backwards also plays a forward pass. DESIGN_SYSTEM §5: UI ≤300ms, `--ease-out`, entrances scale 0.95 + opacity; Emil: never animate keyboard-initiated repeats at full length. Animations: off and reduced motion correctly stop it (motion probe).
fix: Before → After (why): `animation: csPass 0.6s ease-out` from `translateX(-40px) rotate(-12deg)` → `animation: csPass var(--dur-move) var(--ease-out) both` from `translateX(-16px); opacity: 0`, and add `.go` only when stepping forward (explanatory movement stays under 300ms; no spin; Back should not play a forward handoff).

what: The belt item slide runs 600ms with the weak built-in `ease-out`, from -24px with no opacity, on every step press, three times longer than the engine's equivalent `feed` (240ms).
evidence: go-ch25.css:140-142: `.motion .bl-item.go { animation: blSlide 0.6s ease-out; }` `@keyframes blSlide { from { transform: translateX(-24px); } }`. Motion probe (no-preference): `blSlide:600ms@bl-item go` on each Next; off and reduced motion stop it. Engine `feed 240ms var(--ease-out)` from -24px + opacity (DESIGN_SYSTEM §5 table).
fix: Before → After (why): `animation: blSlide 0.6s ease-out` → `animation: feed var(--dur-ui) var(--ease-out) both` (reuse the engine keyframe: -24px + opacity, 240ms; stepper presses are frequent, so keep them under 300ms).

what: The rack's command strip hard-codes `#111`/`#fff` (and the SVG text `#111`) instead of the colour tokens.
evidence: go-ch23.css:63-65 `.rk-cmd { … background: #111; color: #fff; }`, `.rk-cmd .prompt { color: #fff }`, `.rk-svg text { fill: #111; }`. AUTHORING rule 4: never introduce a colour that is not a token. Contrast itself is fine.
fix: Before → After (why): `background: #111; color: #fff` → `background: var(--foreground); color: var(--background)` and `fill: var(--ink)` (tokens keep one palette; the prompt colour then follows the engine's `.prompt` if the strip ever becomes a real `.term`).

what: Tracer line 16 `ready[i] = d + " ✓"` wraps at the space inside the string literal on phones, leaving `d + "` on one row and `✓"` on the next, which looks like two strings.
evidence: Crop: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-go-21-25/c24-p11a.png (from /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-go-21-25/a24/w390-018-p11.png).
